title: IntentPackage
description: Front matter of an intent package (docs/design: HOTL — Intent Package Template). Intake assigns id before it validates a package against this schema. Checks that need HOTL's state (known people, attached repos, a due date in the future, a source link that resolves) are intake's, not the schema's.

id.description: Intent id assigned by intake, for example INT-0042; never set by hand.

org.description: Organization the intent belongs to (ADR 0024). Defaults to the default organization when omitted.

project.description: Project within the organization that the intent targets (ADR 0024).

title.description: Short name of the feature, under 80 characters.

po.description: Product owner: a known person with the PO role.

developer.description: Developer who runs it: a known person with the developer role; the default brief recipient.

repo_hints.description: Optional repo hints: repos the developer expects the change to touch. Each must be attached to HOTL. Hints only guide the scoper, which decides the run's real scope from the knowledge graph (ADR 0018).

repos.description: Deprecated since v0.12.0: use repo_hints. Packages written before scoping name their target repos here; they are read as hints (ADR 0018).

autonomy.description: L1 agent proposes, human approves; L2 agent acts, human can veto; L3 agents merge to main once all gates pass.

due.description: Due date, YYYY-MM-DD; optional. Intake checks it is a real date in the future.

source.description: Link to the PO's original request; optional.
